grades.lower_bound_mechanism: Conjecture L: geometric 1:2:...:2^n partition, superincreasing A≥d via pairing/merge lemmas; rigorously proved only for n≤2
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: all-n halving bound V≤1/2+δ/2 (non-tight) plus unproved Conjecture X; tight exhaustive arguments only for n≤2
grades.notes: Correct closed form 2^n/(2^{n+1}-1) is stated only as a conjecture for n≥3; rigorous two-direction proofs exist solely for n=1,2. Reduction to odd-position/alternating sum is asserted as 'standard', not proved. General-n lower (Conjecture L) and upper (Conjecture X) are formulated with partial lemmas; interleaving case open. Earlier 5/9 guess disproved in-text.
